scope: J10 to Windows serial verification; one RAM-only U-Boot console trial followed by reboot to original saved environment. Selected outputs only; identifiers and unrelated boot logs omitted.

uboot.prompt: Press <SPACE> key to stop autoboot in  2s
uboot.acpipara_before: setenv bootargs rw acpi=on acpi_rsdp=${acpi_rsdp} console=ttyS0,115200n8
uboot.acpipara_trial: setenv bootargs rw acpi=on acpi_rsdp=${acpi_rsdp} console=tty0
uboot.acpipara_after_reboot: setenv bootargs rw acpi=on acpi_rsdp=${acpi_rsdp} console=ttyS0,115200n8

kernel_image_checks.interpretation: Image and decompressed /boot/vmlinuz differ. Absence of nospcr string is supporting evidence, not a direct boot test of that parameter.

limitations: No PSDK execution or 24 V request.
Linux serial console is not released.
PC enumeration does not prove aircraft enumeration.
No kernel binary, ACPI table or saved U-Boot environment modified.
